html:
Namaste!!!

Stray Dog is on it’s way to Singapore on a family trip. Although they issued a visa but I heard they do not have stray dogs in Singapore. So, let me see if he will be allowed there.

This also means that he will not be bugging you with blogs till 27th May, 2011. You may open your Facebook without worrying to get flooded by stray dog barks :).

This also means, he will not be sticking to his commitment to post a a blog everyday. You may have noticed that he removed that little image from right column.

But it is not time yet to take a sigh of relief. Once he is back. he will continue doing what he did in past. He will try to accumulate his observations during this period.

– Stray Dog
